prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished landscape 16:9 original 2D side-scrolling action-adventure concept art board for Whale Fall: Echoes of the Tide, V4.2. Image 1 is ONLY the owned protagonist identity reference. Image 2 is ONLY the owned clean hand-drawn rendering reference, not a layout to repeat. Visual language: confident dark ink outlines, broad 2-3 tone cel masses, sparse dry-brush texture, moody poetic underwater ruin atmosphere, very dark foreground silhouettes, crisply readable playable midground, faded low-contrast background, readable enemies and landing surfaces. Entire world is within one dead whale; shell settlements and red repair knots signify an extinct miniature culture. Hero is 30cm and three heads tall, with a single circular dark diving lens in round ivory helmet, short petrol-teal cape, charcoal webbed feet, sealed amber hip lamp, U-shaped two-prong bone resonator tethered by coral-red rope. Keep hero small (6-9 percent frame height) in gameplay scenes. No human masonry, castle, cathedral, fire, underwater air horizon, blood gore, swords, horns, paired black eye holes, white little knight, insect kingdom, stag stations, recognizable Hollow Knight characters, logos or UI. This is original IP; interpret hand-drawn atmospheric action principles, never copy specific game assets. 
Scene-specific brief: An original game art and UI concept sheet, three large panels. LEFT 50 percent: cozy underwater empty-shell rest habitat attached to a whale mucosal ledge, red repair ropes, sealed microbial lamps, tiny original Tidekeeper crouching and adjusting its amber hip lantern; no fire, no bench, no human building. U-fork resting clearly nearby. TOP RIGHT: enlarged anatomical cutaway of amber hip lamp with exactly TWO different inset symbiont chambers, one leaf-shaped motility chamber and one circular resonance chamber, six distinct tiny marine microbial specimen drawings around them, subtle connector lines. BOTTOM RIGHT: original minimalist map UI concept, branching ORGANIC room blocks with explored solid paths, dotted seen paths, shell camp icons, a few gate shapes; narrow rectangular resonance gauge with four segments and separate 4 to 6 small olive leaf-shaped health marks. Deep midnight-blue background, amber typography placeholders as simple short bars, no readable text besides 01/02. No mask health icons, no charm grid, no ornate gothic borders, no recognizable existing game's HUD. Hand-inked flat design suitable for an indie 2D ocean exploration game.
